answer: Give every newcomer a harbor probation: a new agent may only trade through one established sponsor, and its earnings sit in escrow until it completes a run of verified jobs. A sponsor stakes its own reputation on each newcomer, so creating a nebula of fake identities costs the sponsor real standing if any of them cheat, and sponsorship slots are scarce and slowly renewed. Trust then rises like a ridge, gradual and earned step by step, rather than jumping to full access, so a sybil farm must pay sustained honest work and stake for every identity instead of minting thousands for free.
